text.p: Brazilian midfielder Rivaldo has signed for Barcelona, club president Jose Luis Nunez confirmed on Friday.
The Catalan club paid four billion pesetas ($25.7 million) to buy out Rivaldo's contract with Deportivo La Coruna, the most expensive transfer between two Spanish clubs.
Rivaldo has signed a six-year contract which will pay him 200 million pesetas ($1.3 million) per season.
He scored 21 goals in his 41 matches for Deportivo last season after moving from Brazilian club Palmeiras.
The Brazilian is expected to make his debut for his new club against Italian side Sampdoria in a friendly at the Nou Camp stadium on Saturday.

Rivaldo is the latest in a series of big-money signings by Barcelona who have bought internationals Sonny Anderson, Dragan Ciric, Christophe Dugarry, Ruud Hesp and Michael Reiziger since the end of last season.
But a 12 million pounds ($19 million) bid to sign Liverpool's Steve McManaman failed on Thursday after the club and the player failed to agree personal terms.
